Han.name: Liu Long
Han.title: Emperor Shang
Han.note: An infant; Empress Dowager Deng ruled.

Han.name: Liu Xie
Han.title: Emperor Xian
Han.note: From 196 Cao Cao held real power.

Protectorate of the Western Regions.name: Chen Mu
Protectorate of the Western Regions.title: Protector General
Protectorate of the Western Regions.note: Killed when the oasis states rose in 75.

Protectorate of the Western Regions.name: Ban Yong
Protectorate of the Western Regions.title: Chief Clerk of the Western Regions
Protectorate of the Western Regions.note: Not protector; led Han power in the Western Regions after 123.
Protectorate of the Western Regions.note_zh: 非都护，123年后主持西域事务。

Southern Xiongnu.name: Yu
Southern Xiongnu.title: Huduershi Chanyu
Southern Xiongnu.title_zh: 呼都而尸道皋若鞮单于
Southern Xiongnu.note: Chanyu of all the Xiongnu before the split of 48.

Southern Xiongnu.name: Bi
Southern Xiongnu.title: Chanyu Huhanye II (Southern Xiongnu)
Southern Xiongnu.title_zh: 南匈奴醢落尸逐鞮单于
Southern Xiongnu.note: Led the Southern Xiongnu to submit to Han.

Southern Xiongnu.name: Huchuquan
Southern Xiongnu.title: Chanyu Huchuquan
Southern Xiongnu.note: Kept at Cao Cao's court from 216; the chanyu title lapsed.
Southern Xiongnu.note_zh: 216年被曹操留于邺，单于之位名存实亡。

trung-sisters.note: The rising began in 40; Ma Yuan crushed it in 43.
trung-sisters.note_zh: 起义始于40年，43年被马援镇压。

sides.name: Han and oasis allies
sides.troops_text: 36 men at first, later tens of thousands of local allies
sides.troops_text_zh: 起初仅36人，后有数万西域盟军

sides.name: Xiongnu-backed oasis states and Kushan (Yuezhi)
sides.name_zh: 亲匈奴诸国与贵霜（月氏）

ban-chao.note: Ban Chao fought in the Western Regions from 73 to 102.
ban-chao.note_zh: 班超经营西域自73年至102年。

sides.name: Han and allies
sides.troops_text_zh: 连同南匈奴盟军四万余骑（史载）

yellow-turbans.note: The main rising was crushed within a year, but smaller revolts went on for decades.
yellow-turbans.note_zh: 主力一年内被镇压，余部此后多年仍起事。

anti-dong-coalition.note: Dong Zhuo abandoned Luoyang, but the coalition broke up without defeating him.
anti-dong-coalition.note_zh: 董卓放弃洛阳西迁，联军却未能击败他而自行瓦解。

sides.name: Cao Cao
sides.troops_text_zh: 远少于袁军（《三国志》称不满万）

guandu.note: Cao Cao won by burning Yuan Shao's grain store at Wuchao.
guandu.note_zh: 曹操奇袭乌巢烧毁袁军粮草而取胜。

red-cliffs.note: Huang Gai's fire ships set Cao Cao's chained fleet ablaze; disease also struck Cao's army.
red-cliffs.note_zh: 黄盖火船焚烧曹军战船，曹军又遭疫病。

xiaoyao-ford.note: Zhang Liao opened the battle with a sortie of 800 men.
xiaoyao-ford.note_zh: 张辽率八百人出城突袭。

sides.name: Liu Bei's army under Guan Yu

fancheng.note: Guan Yu first won when floods drowned Yu Jin's relief army, then lost Jingzhou to Lü Meng.
fancheng.note_zh: 关羽先借洪水大破于禁援军，后被吕蒙袭取荆州。
fancheng.losses: Yu Jin's seven armies (c. 30,000) lost in the flood
fancheng.losses_zh: 于禁七军（约3万）在洪水中覆没

routes.name: Silk Road
routes.summary: Caravans carried silk west from Luoyang through the Hexi Corridor and the Tarim oases toward Central Asia.
routes.summary_zh: 商队从洛阳出发，经河西走廊和西域绿洲，把丝绸运往中亚。

routes.name: Ma Yuan's march to Jiaozhi
routes.summary: Ma Yuan led a Han army and fleet south along the coast to put down the Trưng sisters' rising.
routes.summary_zh: 马援率汉军水陆并进，沿海南下镇压征氏姐妹起义。

routes.name: Ban Chao in the Western Regions
routes.summary: Ban Chao went west with a small party and won back the Tarim oases for Han.
routes.summary_zh: 班超率少数随从西行，为东汉重新收复西域诸国。

routes.name: Dou Xian's campaign to Mount Yanran
routes.summary: Han cavalry rode from the Jilu frontier pass deep into Mongolia; the path is approximate.
routes.summary_zh: 汉军骑兵出鸡鹿塞深入漠北，路线为大致示意。

routes.name: Dong Zhuo moves the court to Chang'an
routes.summary: Dong Zhuo burned Luoyang and forced the emperor and its people west to Chang'an.
routes.summary_zh: 董卓焚毁洛阳，挟持献帝与百姓西迁长安。

routes.name: Cao Cao's southern campaign to Red Cliffs
routes.summary: Cao Cao took Jingzhou and sailed down the Yangtze, but was beaten at Red Cliffs.
routes.summary_zh: 曹操取荆州后顺江东下，在赤壁大败。

people.name: Wang Chong
people.known_for: Sceptical philosopher who attacked superstition and argued from evidence.
people.known_for_zh: 怀疑论思想家，批判迷信，主张以事实验证言论。

people.name: Ban Gu
people.known_for: Wrote the Book of Han, the model for later dynastic histories.
people.known_for_zh: 撰写《汉书》，成为后世断代史的典范。

people.name: Ban Zhao
people.known_for: China's first known woman historian; she completed the Book of Han after her brother's death.
people.known_for_zh: 中国已知最早的女史学家，在兄长班固去世后续成《汉书》。

people.name: Xu Shen
people.known_for: Compiled the first Chinese dictionary to analyse characters by their radicals.
people.known_for_zh: 编成第一部按部首分析汉字的字书。

people.name: Zhang Heng
people.known_for: Court astronomer, mathematician and poet who built water-driven and earthquake instruments.
people.known_for_zh: 东汉太史令，天文学家、数学家和文学家，制造了水运浑象和地动仪。

works.title: Rhapsody on Returning to the Fields

people.line_en: In the fine month of mid-spring, the air is mild and clear.

people.name: Zheng Xuan
people.known_for: Leading classical scholar whose commentaries unified the Confucian classics.
people.known_for_zh: 经学大师，遍注群经，融合今古文经学。

people.name: Cai Yong
people.known_for: Scholar, calligrapher and musician who wrote out the classics carved on the Xiping stones.
people.known_for_zh: 东汉学者、书法家和音乐家，书写了刻于熹平石经的儒家经典。

people.name: Zhang Zhongjing
people.known_for: Physician honoured as the 'Sage of Medicine' for his treatise on fevers.
people.known_for_zh: 被尊为“医圣”，所著医书奠定了中医辨证论治的基础。

works.title: Treatise on Cold Damage and Miscellaneous Diseases

people.name: Hua Tuo
people.known_for: Famed surgeon said to use an anaesthetic powder (mafeisan) and the 'Five Animals' exercises.
people.known_for_zh: 东汉名医，相传用麻沸散施行外科手术，并创五禽戏。

people.name: Emperor Guangwu of Han (Liu Xiu)
people.known_for: Restorer of the Han who won the Battle of Kunyang and founded the Eastern Han at Luoyang.
people.known_for_zh: 昆阳之战大破新军，重建汉朝，定都洛阳。

people.name: Ma Yuan
people.known_for: 'Wave-Calming General' who suppressed the Trung sisters' revolt and vowed to die wrapped in a horse hide.
people.known_for_zh: 伏波将军，平定交趾二征起事，“马革裹尸”。

people.name: Deng Yu
people.known_for: Liu Xiu's chief strategist and first of the Twenty-Eight Generals of Yuntai.
people.known_for_zh: 光武帝首席谋臣，云台二十八将之首。

people.name: Wu Han
people.known_for: Grand marshal who conquered Gongsun Shu's Chengdu, completing the Eastern Han reunification.
people.known_for_zh: 大司马，攻灭公孙述，完成东汉统一。

people.name: Geng Yan
people.known_for: General who conquered Shandong for Liu Xiu, praised as 'where there is a will there is a way'.
people.known_for_zh: 平定齐地的名将，光武帝赞其“有志者事竟成”。

people.name: Gongsun Shu
people.known_for: Warlord who declared himself emperor of Chengjia in Sichuan until conquered by Eastern Han.
people.known_for_zh: 割据蜀地称帝，国号成家，后为东汉所灭。

people.name: Wei Xiao
people.known_for: Warlord of Longxi who wavered between Liu Xiu and Gongsun Shu, inspiring the phrase 'having won Long, eye Shu'.
people.known_for_zh: 割据陇右的军阀，留下“得陇望蜀”典故。

people.name: Yan Guang
people.known_for: Recluse friend of Liu Xiu who refused office to fish on the Fuchun River, a model of integrity.
people.known_for_zh: 光武帝故友，拒绝出仕，隐居富春江垂钓。

check.n: Wikipedia gives c. 1-75; Chinese sources give 39 BC-AD 41. Sources disagree.
check.n_zh: 英文维基作约1—75年，中文资料作前39—41年，说法分歧。

people.name: Ban Biao
people.known_for: Historian who began the continuation of Sima Qian's records that became the Book of Han; father of Ban Gu and Ban Chao.
people.known_for_zh: 史学家，续写《史记》，为《汉书》奠基，班固、班超之父。

people.name: Du Shi
people.known_for: Prefect of Nanyang who invented the water-powered bellows for casting iron.
people.known_for_zh: 南阳太守，发明水排鼓风冶铁。

people.name: Wang Jing
people.known_for: Hydraulic engineer whose 69 CE Yellow River works kept the river stable for some eight centuries.
people.known_for_zh: 水利专家，69年治理黄河，使其安流数百年。

people.name: Empress Ma (Mingde)
people.known_for: Daughter of Ma Yuan and Emperor Ming's frugal empress, who restrained her own clan's power.
people.known_for_zh: 马援之女，汉明帝皇后，崇尚节俭，抑制外戚。

people.name: Ban Chao
people.known_for: General who 'threw down the brush' and spent 30 years restoring Han control over the Western Regions.
people.known_for_zh: 投笔从戎，经营西域三十年，任西域都护。

people.name: Dou Xian
people.known_for: General who crushed the Northern Xiongnu in 89 CE and carved a victory inscription on Mount Yanran.
people.known_for_zh: 大破北匈奴，燕然山勒石记功。

people.name: Gan Ying
people.known_for: Envoy sent by Ban Chao in 97 CE toward Rome, reaching the Persian Gulf, the farthest west of any Han official.
people.known_for_zh: 97年奉班超之命出使大秦，抵达波斯湾，为汉使最西远者。

people.name: Jia Kui
people.known_for: Classicist and astronomer who championed the Zuo Commentary and observed lunar motion irregularities.
people.known_for_zh: 经学家、天文学家，推崇《左传》，发现月行迟疾。

people.name: Cai Lun
people.known_for: Court eunuch who presented an improved papermaking process from bark, hemp and rags in 105 CE.
people.known_for_zh: 宦官，105年改进造纸术，“蔡侯纸”。

people.name: Empress Deng Sui
people.known_for: Learned empress dowager who governed the Eastern Han for 16 years through famine and war.
people.known_for_zh: 博学的皇太后，临朝十六年，应对天灾边患。

people.name: Ma Rong
people.known_for: Leading classicist who taught thousands, including Zheng Xuan and Lu Zhi, and annotated the classics.
people.known_for_zh: 东汉经学大师，门生千人，郑玄、卢植皆出其门。

people.name: Wang Fu
people.known_for: Reclusive critic whose Comments of a Recluse attacked corruption and frontier neglect.
people.known_for_zh: 隐居思想家，著《潜夫论》，抨击时政腐败。

people.name: Ban Yong
people.known_for: Son of Ban Chao who restored Han authority in the Western Regions in the 120s.
people.known_for_zh: 班超之子，任西域长史，重新恢复汉对西域的控制。

people.name: Liang Ji
people.known_for: Overbearing consort-kin regent who poisoned an emperor and dominated court until purged in 159.
people.known_for_zh: 跋扈外戚，毒杀质帝，专权近二十年后被诛。

people.name: Li Gu
people.known_for: Upright minister who opposed Liang Ji over the imperial succession and was executed.
people.known_for_zh: 刚正大臣，反对梁冀立帝，遭陷害致死。

people.name: Li Ying
people.known_for: Leader of the scholar-officials against eunuch power, killed in the Disasters of Partisan Prohibitions.
people.known_for_zh: 清流领袖，对抗宦官，死于党锢之祸。

people.name: Chen Fan
people.known_for: Grand tutor who plotted with Dou Wu to purge the eunuchs and was killed when the plot failed.
people.known_for_zh: 太傅，与窦武谋诛宦官，事败被杀。

people.name: Guo Tai
people.known_for: Renowned judge of character and leader of the Imperial Academy students during the partisan struggles.
people.known_for_zh: 太学生领袖，善品评人物，名重天下。

people.name: Zhang Daoling
people.known_for: Founder of the Way of the Celestial Masters, the first organised Daoist religious movement.
people.known_for_zh: 创立五斗米道（天师道），道教正式教团之始。

people.name: An Shigao
people.known_for: Parthian prince-turned-monk who made the first known Chinese translations of Buddhist scriptures.
people.known_for_zh: 安息王子出家，最早将佛经译成汉文的译经家。

check.n: Death year unknown; he is only attested as active c. 148-180.
check.n_zh: 卒年不详，仅知活动于约148—180年。

people.name: Zhang Zhi
people.known_for: 'Sage of Cursive Script' whose fluid running cursive shaped Chinese calligraphy.
people.known_for_zh: “草圣”，开创今草书风。

people.name: Liu Hong
people.known_for: Astronomer whose Qianxiang calendar first accounted for the Moon's varying speed.
people.known_for_zh: 天文学家，制定乾象历，首次计入月行迟疾。

people.name: He Xiu
people.known_for: New Text scholar whose commentary on the Gongyang Commentary became its standard reading.
people.known_for_zh: 今文经学家，著《春秋公羊传解诂》。

people.name: Zhang Jue
people.known_for: Daoist faith healer who launched the Yellow Turban Rebellion of 184, shaking the Han dynasty.
people.known_for_zh: 太平道首领，184年发动黄巾起义，动摇汉朝。

people.name: Huangfu Song
people.known_for: Han general who crushed the main Yellow Turban armies in 184.
people.known_for_zh: 东汉名将，镇压黄巾军主力。

people.name: Dong Zhuo
people.known_for: Tyrannical warlord who seized Luoyang, burned it and moved the court to Chang'an before his assassination.
people.known_for_zh: 专权军阀，焚洛阳、迁都长安，后被吕布所杀。

people.name: Lü Bu
people.known_for: Peerless warrior who killed Dong Zhuo and was finally captured and executed by Cao Cao at Xiapi.
people.known_for_zh: 骁勇无双，诛董卓，后在下邳被曹操擒杀。

people.name: Yuan Shao
people.known_for: Leader of the coalition against Dong Zhuo and master of the north until his defeat by Cao Cao at Guandu.
people.known_for_zh: 讨董联军盟主，雄踞河北，官渡之战败于曹操。

people.name: Sun Jian
people.known_for: Governor of Changsha who fought Dong Zhuo and laid the foundations of the Wu state.
people.known_for_zh: 长沙太守，讨伐董卓，奠定东吴基业。

people.name: Sun Ce
people.known_for: 'Little Conqueror' who seized the lands south of the Yangtze, forming the core of Wu.
people.known_for_zh: “小霸王”，平定江东，建立孙吴根基。

people.name: Kong Rong
people.known_for: Descendant of Confucius and one of the Seven Scholars of Jian'an, executed by Cao Cao.
people.known_for_zh: 孔子后裔，建安七子之一，后为曹操所杀。

people.name: Guo Jia
people.known_for: Cao Cao's brilliant strategist whose counsel helped conquer the north.
people.known_for_zh: 曹操谋士，算无遗策，助其统一北方。

people.name: Cao Cao
people.known_for: Warlord-chancellor who unified northern China, founded the base of Cao Wei and was a leading Jian'an poet.
people.known_for_zh: 统一北方的权相、诗人，奠定曹魏基业。

people.name: Guan Yu
people.known_for: Liu Bei's sworn brother who held Jing Province, later deified as a god of war and loyalty.
people.known_for_zh: 刘备结义兄弟，镇守荆州，后被奉为武圣。

people.name: Zhou Yu
people.known_for: Wu commander who destroyed Cao Cao's fleet by fire at the Battle of Red Cliffs.
people.known_for_zh: 东吴都督，赤壁之战火攻大破曹军。

people.name: Lu Su
people.known_for: Wu strategist who proposed the Sun-Liu alliance against Cao Cao.
people.known_for_zh: 东吴谋臣，力主孙刘联盟抗曹。

people.name: Lü Meng
people.known_for: Wu general who studied late in life and captured Jing Province from Guan Yu.
people.known_for_zh: “士别三日当刮目相看”，白衣渡江袭取荆州。

people.name: Xun Yu
people.known_for: Cao Cao's chief adviser who urged him to escort the Han emperor to Xuchang.
people.known_for_zh: 曹操首席谋臣，建议迎奉汉献帝于许。

people.name: Pang Tong
people.known_for: 'Young Phoenix' strategist who planned Liu Bei's conquest of Yi Province but was killed at Luo.
people.known_for_zh: 号凤雏，为刘备谋取益州，战死雒城。

people.name: Fa Zheng
people.known_for: Strategist who helped Liu Bei take Yi Province and Hanzhong.
people.known_for_zh: 刘备谋士，助其取益州、夺汉中。

people.name: Wang Can
people.known_for: Foremost of the Seven Scholars of Jian'an, known for poems on the misery of war.
people.known_for_zh: 建安七子之冠，作《七哀诗》《登楼赋》。

people.name: Xu Gan
people.known_for: Jian'an scholar whose Balanced Discourses discussed ethics and the relation of names and reality.
people.known_for_zh: 建安七子之一，著《中论》。

people.name: Xiahou Dun
people.known_for: Cao Cao's kinsman and senior general, famed for losing an eye in battle.
people.known_for_zh: 曹操宗族大将，作战中失去一目。

people.name: Zhong Yao
people.known_for: Wei statesman and calligrapher regarded as a founder of regular script (kaishu).
people.known_for_zh: 曹魏重臣、书法家，被视为楷书的奠基人。

people.name: Liu Bei
people.known_for: Han royal relative who founded the Shu Han state in Sichuan with Zhuge Liang's help.
people.known_for_zh: 汉室宗亲，得诸葛亮辅佐，建立蜀汉。

people.name: Sun Quan
people.known_for: Founding emperor of Eastern Wu who allied with Liu Bei to defeat Cao Cao at Red Cliffs.
people.known_for_zh: 东吴开国皇帝，联刘抗曹，赤壁大胜。

people.name: Zhuge Liang
people.known_for: Chancellor of Shu Han and legendary strategist, epitome of wisdom and loyalty.
people.known_for_zh: 蜀汉丞相，智慧与忠诚的化身。

people.name: Zhang Fei
people.known_for: Fierce sworn brother of Liu Bei, famed for holding Changban Bridge.
people.known_for_zh: 刘备结义兄弟，当阳长坂桥喝退曹军。

people.name: Zhao Yun
people.known_for: Shu general famed for rescuing Liu Bei's infant son at Changban.
people.known_for_zh: 蜀汉名将，长坂坡单骑救主。

people.name: Lu Xun
people.known_for: Wu general who routed Liu Bei at Yiling in 222 and later became chancellor.
people.known_for_zh: 夷陵之战火烧连营大败刘备，后任东吴丞相。

people.name: Sima Yi
people.known_for: Wei general and regent who resisted Zhuge Liang and seized power in 249, paving the way for Jin.
people.known_for_zh: 曹魏重臣，抵御诸葛亮北伐，高平陵之变夺权。

people.name: Cao Pi
people.known_for: Son of Cao Cao who ended the Han in 220 as first Wei emperor and wrote early literary criticism.
people.known_for_zh: 受汉禅建立曹魏，著《典论·论文》。

people.name: Jia Xu
people.known_for: Shrewd strategist who served several warlords before advising Cao Cao and Cao Pi.
people.known_for_zh: 善于自保的谋士，先后事多主，终为曹魏太尉。

people.name: Zhang Liao
people.known_for: Wei general who routed Sun Quan's huge army at Xiaoyao Ford with 800 men.
people.known_for_zh: 以八百人在逍遥津大破孙权。

people.name: Ma Chao
people.known_for: Liang Province warlord who fought Cao Cao at Tong Pass before joining Liu Bei.
people.known_for_zh: 西凉猛将，潼关大战曹操，后归刘备。

people.name: Zhang Zhao
people.known_for: Senior Wu minister and guardian of Sun Quan, leader of the faction urging peace with Cao Cao.
people.known_for_zh: 东吴元老重臣，受孙策托孤辅佐孙权。

people.name: Lady Zhen
people.known_for: Wife of Cao Pi and mother of Emperor Ming of Wei, celebrated as a great beauty.
people.known_for_zh: 曹丕之妻，魏明帝之母，以美貌著称。

people.name: Yu Fan
people.known_for: Wu Yijing scholar exiled to the far south, where he taught hundreds of students.
people.known_for_zh: 易学家，被流放交州，讲学不倦。

people.name: Jiang Wan
people.known_for: Zhuge Liang's successor as head of the Shu Han government.
people.known_for_zh: 继诸葛亮主持蜀汉朝政。

people.name: Zhuge Jin
people.known_for: Elder brother of Zhuge Liang who served Wu as a trusted general and diplomat.
people.known_for_zh: 诸葛亮之兄，东吴大将军，多次出使蜀汉。

people.name: Wang Shuhe
people.known_for: Physician who compiled the Pulse Classic and re-edited Zhang Zhongjing's treatise.
people.known_for_zh: 医学家，著《脉经》，整理《伤寒论》。

check.n: Chinese Wikipedia gives Wang Shuhe as c. 210?–258?, not 180–270.
check.n_zh: 中文维基百科称王叔和约生于210年、卒于258年，而非180–270年。

capitals.name: Luoyang
capitals.note: Burned when Dong Zhuo forced the court west in 190.
capitals.note_zh: 190年董卓挟持朝廷西迁，焚毁洛阳。

capitals.name: Chengdu
capitals.note: Gongsun Shu's rival empire, conquered by Han in 36.
capitals.note_zh: 公孙述所建政权，36年为汉所灭。

capitals.name: Chang'an
capitals.note: Dong Zhuo moved the court here; Emperor Xian fled east in 195.
capitals.note_zh: 董卓迁都于此，195年汉献帝东归。

capitals.name: Xu
capitals.note: Cao Cao brought Emperor Xian here in 196.

capitals.name: Ye
capitals.note: Seat of Cao Cao's Kingdom of Wei inside the Han empire.
capitals.note_zh: 曹操受封魏公、魏王后的都城。
